package contract

import (
	"context"

	ext "github.com/moby/extensions"
	stream "github.com/moby/extensions/stream"
)

type Service interface {
	Unary(context.Context, *Request) (*Reply, error)
	Remove(context.Context, *Request) error
	Download(context.Context, *Request, stream.Sender[Chunk]) error
	DownloadAgain(context.Context, *Request, stream.Sender[Chunk]) error
	Upload(context.Context, stream.Receiver[Chunk]) (*Reply, error)
	UploadAgain(context.Context, stream.Receiver[Chunk]) (*AlternateReply, error)
}

type Request struct {
	Value int32 `pb:"1"`
}

type Chunk struct {
	Value int32  `pb:"1"`
	Data  []byte `pb:"2"`
}

type Reply struct {
	Values []int32 `pb:"1"`
}

type AlternateReply struct {
	Values []int32 `pb:"1"`
	Marker string  `pb:"2"`
}

var Point = ext.DefinePoint[Service]("org.example.generated.runtime.v1")
